statement: (V : Type*) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hG : G.IsRegularOfDegree 3) (s : ℕ) (hs : s = Fintype.card V / 2 + 1) (hs3 : 3 ≤ s) (U : Finset V) (hU : U.card = Fintype.card V / 2) (ha : s < (G.induce (↑U : Set V)).edgeSet.ncard) (u v : V) (hu : u ∈ U) (hv : v ∉ U) (hnu : ∀ w, G.Adj u w → w ∈ U) (hnv : ∀ w, G.Adj v w → w ∉ U) : ¬ G.Adj u v ∧ (insert v (U.erase u)).card = Fintype.card V / 2 ∧ (G.induce (↑(insert v (U.erase u)) : Set V)).edgeSet.ncard = (G.induce (↑U : Set V)).edgeSet.ncard - 3
closed: ∀ (V : Type*) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hG : G.IsRegularOfDegree 3) (s : ℕ) (hs : s = Fintype.card V / 2 + 1) (hs3 : 3 ≤ s) (U : Finset V) (hU : U.card = Fintype.card V / 2) (ha : s < (G.induce (↑U : Set V)).edgeSet.ncard) (u v : V) (hu : u ∈ U) (hv : v ∉ U) (hnu : ∀ w, G.Adj u w → w ∈ U) (hnv : ∀ w, G.Adj v w → w ∉ U), ¬ G.Adj u v ∧ (insert v (U.erase u)).card = Fintype.card V / 2 ∧ (G.induce (↑(insert v (U.erase u)) : Set V)).edgeSet.ncard = (G.induce (↑U : Set V)).edgeSet.ncard - 3
informal: Section 3: replacement decreases a by three
original:
Assume now that $a\,(=c)>s$ .
The average degrees of the subgraphs of $G$ induced by $U$ and $V(G)\setminus U$ are equal and are given by $\overline{d}_{U}$ , where

 $\overline{d}_{U}=\frac{2a}{n/2}=\frac{2a}{s-1}>\frac{2s}{s-1}>2.$ 

It follows that we can find a vertex $u\in U$ (resp.  $v\in V(G)\setminus U$ ) all three of whose neighbors are in $U$ (resp.  $V(G)\setminus U$ ).
Note that $u$ and $v$ are not adjacent.
We update $U$ as follows:

 $U\leftarrow(U\setminus\{u\})\cup\{v\}.$ 

Observe that $|U|$ remains $n/2$ , and that the integer $a$ is then updated as

 $a\leftarrow a-3.$
